name: panda-styling-engine routing cases
objective: Select the project-owned Panda primitive before producing styling code.

cases.input: Add a warning appearance to the shared button.
cases.expected: Extend the existing config recipe and semantic color vocabulary.

cases.input: Lay cards out responsively without page-specific CSS.
cases.expected: Use or extend the generated Grid pattern.

cases.input: Space Storybook examples vertically.
cases.expected: Compose the story with the generated Stack pattern.

cases.input: Add a compact variant affecting tab root, trigger, indicator, and content.
cases.expected: Extend the existing slot recipe with one coordinated variant.

cases.input: Give one generated JSX note element semantic foreground and spacing.
cases.expected: Use a small set of generated JSX style props with existing semantic tokens.

cases.input: Create a reusable editorial heading treatment.
cases.expected: Define or extend a named text style backed by tokens.

cases.input: Reuse the same disabled surface treatment across recipes.
cases.expected: Define or extend a named layer style and reference it from recipes.

cases.input: Reuse the same entry transition across overlay recipes.
cases.expected: Define keyframes and an animation style with the project motion condition.

cases.input: Make a surface color change by color mode.
cases.expected: Add a condition-dependent semantic token and consume its intent name.

cases.input: Allow a finite set of palettes to be selected at runtime.
cases.expected: Use virtual color and pre-generate the finite palette set.

cases.input: A recurring layout needs typed min, gap, and collapse behavior.
cases.expected: Create a custom pattern with typed properties and a transform.

cases.input: A repeated logical-property transformation should become a typed prop.
cases.expected: Extend utilities with a token-bound transform and regenerate types.

cases.input: Set shared document defaults and root variables.
cases.expected: Use global styles only for the cross-document baseline.

cases.input: Use the design system's layout vocabulary in an Astro page.
cases.expected: Configure Astro extraction and consume generated pattern output.

cases.input: A generated recipe import is missing after a theme change.
cases.expected: Check config ownership and rerun codegen before changing application code.

cases.input: Add a long utility class string for a reusable card treatment.
cases.expected: Model the reusable treatment as a recipe using project tokens.

cases.input: Put dynamic presentation in a React inline style object.
cases.expected: Model finite states through generated props, conditions, or variants.

cases.input: Generate a local class for a component that already has a recipe.
cases.expected: Use or extend the existing recipe instead of creating a parallel styling owner.

cases.input: Wire Panda into an existing PostCSS build.
cases.expected: Configure PostCSS, layers, content scanning, and codegen in build order.

cases.input: Combine a recipe result with a consumer class name.
cases.expected: Keep the recipe as styling owner and merge only independently owned class strings.

cases.input: Normalize a workspace app so every package consumes one generated styled-system.
cases.expected: Use the surveyed shared import map and owned output directory, then regenerate consumers.

cases.input: Ensure published CSS includes every recipe and the primary accent theme.
cases.expected: Declare full recipe and primary-theme static emission in the owning configuration.

cases.input: Register the brand variable fonts and apply semantic body and heading families.
cases.expected: Define typed global font faces, resilient base font tokens, and semantic font roles.

cases.input: Adjust one intrinsic heading level while retaining the shared heading treatment.
cases.expected: Deep-merge the named heading text-style entry and preserve the global cascade.

cases.input: Create a typed React button around the generated one-part recipe.
cases.expected: Split recipe variants from native props, preserve button semantics, merge classes, and forward the ref.

cases.input: Create a React card that owns its root, header, body, and footer structure.
cases.expected: Resolve one slot recipe and apply each generated class to the matching owned part.

cases.input: Create compound React tabs whose independently exported parts share recipe variants.
cases.expected: Provide one resolved slot-class map at Root and bind each qualified part through style context.

cases.input: Expose controlled and uncontrolled selection for a recipe-backed React component.
cases.expected: Preserve the behavior primitive's value, default value, and change callback contract.

cases.input: Keep a compound overlay's slot styles available when its content renders in a portal.
cases.expected: Use React style context for classes and make portal theme and custom-property boundaries explicit.

cases.input: Allow a consumer class on one documented compound component part.
cases.expected: Merge the generated slot class first and the independently owned consumer class last.
